name: Ember Wake
summary: Leaves a trail of flames behind you as you move.

stats.effect: For the duration, each time you move at least 10 feet on your turn you leave a trail of fire in the spaces you passed. A creature that enters or ends its turn in the trail makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save or no damage on a successful one. The trail lasts until the start of your next turn.
